name: San Fang Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: San Fang Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells artificial leather, synthetic resin, and other materials in Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company provides polyurethane synthetic leathers; full grain and nubuck synthetic leathers; fibers, such as multi and mono filaments, recycled dope dyed yarn, and thermoplastic polyester elastomer (TPEE) elastic fibers; and hot melt, TPU+hot melt, TPU, and multi-layer films for shoes, as well as films, hot melt, water-proof tapes, elastic hot melt, and decoration hot melt films for apparel.
